summary: The Backrooms is a shared multiplayer survival RPG across the Level 0 maze, mall, The Hub and authored destinations. Player state carries progression, gear, quests and resume location; shared scripts and place simulations provide common player behavior, world dressing and story systems.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and deterministic generated dressing; wallside moments include fitted vending machine, chair, sleeping-bag camp and wall-hung steel payphone pair.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; authored placements live in cells/.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations, Doorstep Carpet and Camp Amber crews; Level 1 entrance and return marker are in x0z0.scene and sim.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office, supplies, HALOGEN machine, encounters and story beats.
places/level1 (3D) - far-west Level 1 halls and M.E.G. camp; sim builds camp and adds the Hub-arrival marker beside its return door.

places/level9 + places/level11 (3D) - The Suburbs seeded streets and fitted houses; Level 11's Sedco Spotlight/city, Base Beta and generated quest locations, including mall fixtures in scripts/l11-mall.js.

places/level61 (3D, The Snackrooms) - food court and M.E.G. checkpoint with storefronts, simulated staff/services and Clippers cocktail lounge; payphones use a fitted steel pair with a separately placed PUBLIC PHONES sign.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input actions; fall-guard runs before locomotion and player behavior.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and place generation/tick behavior; Level 61 delegates storefront fixtures/services to shared helpers.

scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts + scripts/ui.js - title/settings/pause, character creation and arrival; main-menu drives tutorial beats and lifecycle, tutorial-ui and composed HUD/menus.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player actions/state, wake/resume, aiming, third-person view and HUD zone naming.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + xmas-room.js + level0-moments.js - Level 0 layout and deterministic dressing/encounters; moments versioning regenerates fitted wall props and camp.

places/thehub/sim.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + hub-people.js + hub-dress.js + scripts/thehub-geo.js - Hub topology, doors, dressing and crew; Phoebe uses scripts/lib/phoebe.js and scripts/phoebe-npc.js.
scripts/lib/level61-quests.js + scripts/talk.js + scripts/quest-marker.js - Level 6.1 cross-level quest definitions, dialogue handling and journal-marker registration.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + preload data/scripts - Bonus shared-room routing, solo IDs, home destinations, labels and proximity preload; distinct from places/thehub.
scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - canonical Hub tunnels, open/keyed/sealed door registry, key inventory and position helpers; shared by geometry, simulation, quests, doors and UI.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - common loot/items and weapon variants; weapon-look selects fitted meshes or scripted geometry.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js + scripts/lib/ui-theme.js - escaping, preference normalization/attributes, Escape handling, empty states, notice toasts and shared dialogue styling.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - parametric doors/motion, paired Level 3 hatches and tagged-seat placement/occupancy helpers.
scripts/lib/data/l9-houses.yml + l9-props.yml + scripts/lib/level9.js - Level 9 house/model/door and prop catalogs plus pure seed-driven layout; consumed by places/level9/sim.js and zone lookup.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js - fitted furniture catalog and common build placement/persistence/reconstruction; dining_set composes a table with two separately fitted chairs.

scripts/lib/phoebe.js - shared Phoebe look, model selection, spawn and dressPhoebe fitting for Hub and story scenes; dialogue/check helpers remain shared through scripts/lib/dialogue.js and data/dlg-*.yml.
notableExports: scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, hasHalogen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V, sw194, furrySpec, restyle, restyleQueue, restyleStep, restylePlace; scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, stagger3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands.
scripts/lib/level9.js - HOUSES, ROAD_W, rng, hashStr, yawFacing, layout, zoneAt; places/level9/sim.js - cadence, tick.

scripts/lib/level31-quest.js + level31-parts.js - venue geometry/zones/arrivals/skating/layParts; scripts/lib/ch2-quest.js - CH2, REPLIES and Chapter 2 quest stage/dialogue handlers including completeChapter2.
scripts/lib/level70-quest.js + scripts/terrain70.js - Level 70 quest, terrain and civic/life layer exports.
scripts/lib/errands.js - ERRANDS, held, errandText, offerErrand, payErrand, tryAlt, deliberateErrands, turnInErrand, errandTick; scripts/lib/rep.js - faction and reputation helpers.

scripts/lib/skill-check.js - SKILL_NAMES, parseCheck, checkOdds, formatCheckBanner, resolveCheck; scripts/lib/level61-quests.js - QUESTS61 and quest handlers; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - TRAIL and trail helpers.

scripts/lib/level0-moments.js - wallPose, layMoments; places/main/sim.js - cadence, dress, tick; scripts/lib/tutorial.js - STEPS, tutStart, tutJump, tutTick, tutInput; scripts/player.js - takeToken (optional XP suppression).
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression, XP/level, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, tapes, currency, karma/rep and homeKeep.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats derived stats.
scripts/critter.js - per-player look and creator/wardrobe/salon state; scripts/lib/seat.js - player.state.sit seating lifecycle; scripts/lib/body3.js - session.ready3 and transient melee-carry pose.
scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - quests/qtrack/qdone/claimed; Dina trail keys, stages, diary/cut/clue fields and legacy migration.

scripts/lib/errands.js - player.state.errands records, errHints and errand journal entries; completion updates currency, payout, reputation and hints; field-errands.js + hub-errands.js own confirmation maps.

scripts/lib/level31-quest.js + level70-quest.js + remodel-quest.js + scripts/lib/level11-quests.js + scripts/lib/level61-quests.js + scripts/lib/ch2-quest.js - level-specific quest stages/routes/rewards; Chapter 2 owns ch2Q/ch2Done and its clues/outcomes.
scripts/lib/level61-quests.js owns l61BeeQ/l61SealQ/l61GuildQ/l61SalQ and clue/survey/ruling/delivery/outcome flags; scripts/lib/level11-quests.js owns craneQ and craneWaybill/craneGuildClear.

scripts/player.js owns XP and Level ! session/cut/rescue fields; saved per-host OS unlock and boiler-pick reward markers also live in player.state; scripts/quest-marker.js owns qfilter/qview, tutorial.js owns tut, fall-guard.js owns transient session safety fields.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest and CCTV behaviors; scripts/interact.js handles tagged-seat selection and seatTick.

templates/player.js runs scripts/fall-guard.js update before movement; place changes hold velocity until ground appears, grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and onOutOfBounds restores it or leaves for the level spawn.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; body3 tick3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose; zoneHere feeds maze/authored zone lookups.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; periodic saves exclude intake, bonus and tutorial0.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to mall/home and maintain roomHop/save-place, separate from places/thehub; fresh visit → main-menu.js.

scripts/main-menu-ui.js settings → scripts/main-menu.js mmenu handler → player.state.uiPrefs; scripts/ui.js wraps composed UI with ui-kit preference attributes; menu actions update inventory filters/sorts and journal state.

scripts/player.js writes player.state.notice and scripts/stats.js forwards fresh notices into feed → scripts/ui.js renders ui-kit noticeToast; talk-ui and other panels use shared escaping and ui-theme styling.
scripts/main-menu.js errandTick → scripts/lib/errands.js offers place-matched jobs; carried items/kills/world events advance errands → quests.js journal, player.state.errands/qtrack and payouts.

scripts/talk.js → dialogue.js rootChoices and quest handlers; authored dlg-*.yml dialogue and voiceKey mappings feed skill checks and journal/feed/reputation helpers; ch2-quest.js supplies Safe Alcove stance choices and completion.

scripts/main-menu.js arrival → scripts/lib/tutorial.js tutStart; update/input call tutTick/tutInput → player.state.tut and tutorial-ui.js card; tutorial0 sim lays props, while tut0-cut.js runs beats and Dina's HALOGEN handoff.
places/main/sim.js compares place.state.momentsV and calls layMoments → deterministic Level 0 wall/camp placements; v15 destroys tagged moments before relaying the new wall-hung payphone pair.

scripts/craft.js consumes takeToken(..., {xp:false}) for recipe ingredients and processes player.state.payout XP/items; interact/talk and place use handlers suppress XP on transfers/free repeatable grants, while player.js pays normal pickups and only the first Level 0 exit.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon + places/level61/sim.js and scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - authored commercial interiors and simulated staff/services; venue menus and staff vary by shop; Level 6.1 fixture models are fitted separately.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; a dining_set composes a table with two separately fitted chairs.

art/cigs/build.py + art/fnv/build.py and NIF converters → scripts/lib/data/cigs.yml + fnv-props.yml - creator assets become real-scale GLBs; catalogs supply decoration and fitted furniture/props across Levels 5, 9, 11 and 61.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates crawl, tight ceilings/tunnel mouths trigger automatic crawl; Level ! adds context-specific constraints.
Level 01/Zenith and Level 1 geometry builders - authored station and car park/service geometry; corridor materials, pipes, fixtures and lights vary deterministically per cell.

scripts/meg-agent.js + npc-temper.js + forgive.js + critter-model.js - NPC reactions, cover, barks, movement/fighting and companion following vary by faction/role/outfit; Hub and story Phoebes share scripts/lib/phoebe.js dressing.

scripts/lib/level61-quests.js + level11-quests.js + ch2-quest.js + talk/use handlers - level quest stages and replies reuse shared journal/rep/feed helpers and skill-check resolution; scripts/lib/tutorial.js + tut0-cut.js coordinate tutorial prompts/beats.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs, destinations and coordinates together; place.state.hubV gates shell/door/plaque rebuilds (currently v9).

Hub keyed doors consume the matching player.state.hubKeys key; t10-a3 maps to level11 and hubTenthCrossed is set only after a qualifying clue and successful crossing. The Level 1 route is a separate threshold pair with its own arrival marker.

scripts/fall-guard.js uses transient session state, not saved player progress: a place change grants up to 6s for ground to stream in; grounded safe points update at most twice a second and out-of-bounds restores the last known point.

Hub Phoebe uses spawnHubPhoebe's phoebeV (currently 7); scripts/lib/phoebe.js dressPhoebe supplies the shared head/build/bones/bust/jiggle. Its fitted outfit supplies its own hair/skirt, so wardrobe hair and skirt must stay removed.

Level 0 places/main/sim.js momentsV is 15; changing it destroys tagged moment props and deterministically relays them. XP is granted by player.js/takeToken and craft.js payout processing: keep xp:false on transfers/ingredients/free item rewards, and retain one-time reward markers for OS hosts, boiler picks and the first maze exit.
